notes: This is a two-column 1883 session record that Google read row-wise across the gutter. Most full lines are two half-lines from different columns (1, 3-8, 10, 11, 14, 15, 25, 29-40), and 18 and 19 are merged too even though they carry no crossing flag, so the gutter rule would miss them. Many other crops carry a label from a different place entirely: 9, 16, 17, 21, 23, 24, 26, 27 and 28 are crops of 1-3 small lines whose label is another line or a long multi-line run. Only a handful of single-column lines (2, 12, 13, 20) are usable, which is not worth a pattern for a 140-line book.
